newsitem.title: USA: US LPGs steady to weaker in quiet activity.
newsitem.headline: US LPGs steady to weaker in quiet activity.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were steady to slightly lower in a slow start on Monday to the new week, players said.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane was steady at between 34.50 cents and 35.00 cents a gallon, with few deals heard done.

Conway, Kansas, material in the Midwest was down about a quarter cent despite moderate activity among traders. Deals were done at 34.25 cents and 34.12 cents. Sellers were pegged at 34.25 cents at midday.
Meanwhile, players said it was still unlcear if a 200,000-barrel cargo of normal butane Pemex bought from Venezuela last week was to be stored in the U.S. Gulf Coast.
Pemex does not have much storage space and the arrival of barrels into storage in the U.S. could help depress prices, players said.
Belvieu normal butane was steady at 40.50/41.00 cents. Conway material was off a quarter cent at 37.50/38.00 cents.
